notes: Reached the site in a dedicated Chrome tab through the claude-in-chrome connector; no 403, challenge or CAPTCHA at any point. The site is an Angular/Spartacus SPA on SAP Commerce (base site gl-fr). TREE: union of (a) the live category facet rendered on each listing page, (b) the full category sitemap https://www.galerieslafayette.com/siteMap/Category-fr-EUR.xml (1481 category URLs), and (c) the 'categories' facet the site's own search API returns for each parent. All three agree. QTY METHOD: the rendered listing footer reads 'Produits affiches : 72 sur N'. That footer is produced by the SPA's own call to https://sapapi.galerieslafayette.com/occ/v2/gl-fr/products/search, whose 'query' parameter is simply the category URL path - which is why the previous Home-Decor pass, which tried SAP category codes, always got the unfiltered 29600 default. I called that same endpoint from the loaded page context (same browser session, its cookies and CORS) and confirmed it reproduces the rendered header exactly: /mobilier/salon/tables-basses rendered '72 sur 406' and the API returned pagination.totalResults=406. Every leaf qty below is therefore the site's own number, cross-checked a second way against the parent's 'categories' facet count. Child sums reconcile with parents: Salon 111+113+855+5+176+106+406=1772=Salon; Chambre sums to 1021; Bureau 243+41+9=293; Mobilier bebe 11+11=22; Mobilier de jardin 69+47+17+6+6+4+1=150. Mobilier root reads 4778. BAD-SLUG CHECK: an invented slug does not 404 - it returns the site-wide total 29600 with EMPTY breadcrumbs. Every path recorded here returned a non-empty breadcrumb chain ending in the node requested, so no row is a silently substituted parent listing. DUPLICATE BRANCHES: the sitemap also exposes a legacy product-type tree under Mobilier - /assises (+5 children), /canapes-et-fauteuils (+10) and /meubles-de-rangement (+13). All 31 of those URLs are live with correct breadcrumbs but return totalResults=0, appear in no live navigation, and every label duplicates a node in the live room tree (Salon / Salle a manger / Chambre / Bureau / Mobilier bebe / Salle de bain). They are deprecated shells and were not emitted; the live room tree carries all the stock. Same pattern under Garden: /salons-de-jardin has four sitemap children (canapes-de-jardin, chaises-et-fauteuils-de-jardin, ensembles-de-jardin, tables-de-jardin) all at 0, so Salons de jardin is recorded as a leaf at 6. ZERO-PRODUCT LEAVES: five non-duplicate nodes in the live tree return 0 (Banquettes/BZ/clic-clac, Meridiennes, Bouts de lits, Couffins, Tables a langer). They are emitted as qty 0 with a flag. Note the categories facet only lists non-empty children, which is how these were identified. EXCLUDED, with reasons: the whole /literie branch (matelas, surmatelas, ensembles matelas et sommiers, sommiers, accessoires de lit - mattresses and bed bases, i.e. bedding); the whole /rangement branch (kitchen, bathroom, decorative and utility organisers, boxes, baskets, laundry bins - standalone storage goods; its only furniture-adjacent node, Paravents / room dividers at 3, is decorative rather than furniture); Jardin > Decorations de jardin > Coffres de jardin (1, garden storage chests); Mobilier de jardin > Parasols et voiles (4) and > Housses de protection (0, furniture covers, explicitly excluded); and all /fm/ URLs, which are brand facet pages rather than categories. OUT-OF-DEPARTMENT ROWS: two furniture-typed nodes live outside Maison and are included with flags - Gaming Chairs (1, Leisure > Gaming) and High Chairs (56, Kids > Nursery > Mealtime). Department stores cross-list, so the Gaming Chairs case was settled by product ID rather than by count: its single product code 300421067425 does not appear among the 41 codes in Furniture > Office > Office Chairs, so the two nodes are disjoint. NAMING: all node names translated to plain English, following the precedent this company set in the Home-Decor pass; no French retained in parentheses.
